name: Release v0.1.2
body:
## Install

```bash
npm install -g @stigmer/cli
```

## Highlights

Sessions that sleep now run on Agent Substrate v1.0.0. The server's `substrate` sandbox driver speaks v1.0.0's API, which moved to the `substrate.ateapi.v1` package.

The docs front page now opens on your first agent job.

## Upgrading

- **The `substrate` driver in this release can't start a sandbox:** its template names a snapshot location, which Agent Substrate v1.0.0 refuses. Use 0.1.3.
- **Agent Substrate v1.0.0 is required by the `substrate` driver.** Reinstall Substrate at v1.0.0 and deploy this release in the same window. The [runners guide](https://stigmer.ai/docs/guides/self-hosting/runners) lists what the driver needs.

## What's Changed

### Features

- feat(server): speak Agent Substrate v1.0.0 (#2871)

name: Release v0.3.1
body:
## Install

```bash
npm install -g @stigmer/cli
```

## Highlights

**The Stigmer operator's chart is published.** v0.3.0 shipped every image but not the operator's Helm chart. You can now install it as the Kubernetes guide shows: `helm install stigmer-operator oci://ghcr.io/stigmer/charts/stigmer-operator --version 0.3.1 --namespace stigmer-system --create-namespace`, then one `Stigmer` resource. (#3404)

**The server waits for its database at boot instead of restarting.** If Postgres does not answer yet, the server now retries its first connection for up to a minute and logs each retry. (#3404)

## What's Changed

### Bug Fixes

- fix(operator): publish the chart (#3404)

name: Release v0.1.0
body:
## Install

```bash
npm install -g @stigmer/cli
```

## Highlights

This is the first release of Stigmer, the open-source backend for the agents in your product. It runs behind your app, the way your database does.

Run it yourself on a laptop, one server or Kubernetes, open source under Apache 2.0, or use Stigmer Cloud. The quickstart takes you from install to an agent's first report: https://stigmer.ai/docs/getting-started/quickstart

## Upgrading

- 0.1.0 starts a new version line. The 3.x releases are deprecated, and 0.1.0 does not read their data, so start from a fresh install rather than upgrading one.

## What's Changed

- chore: first release (#12)

name: Release v0.3.0
body:
## Install

```bash
npm install -g @stigmer/cli
```

## Highlights

**Kubernetes has one install: the Stigmer operator.** Install it with `helm install stigmer-operator oci://ghcr.io/stigmer/charts/stigmer-operator`, then declare one `Stigmer` resource. (#3394)

**Agent Substrate sandboxes keep their work across a sleep.** A sleeping sandbox keeps the agent's home and the packages its Environment installed. (#3356, #3362, #3367, #3374)

## Upgrading

- **Kubernetes**: the raw-manifest Helm chart `charts/stigmer` is retired and gets no new versions. Install the Stigmer operator instead
  (docs/guides/self-hosting/kubernetes.mdx). (#3394)
- **Bucket artifact store**: `r2` is renamed `s3`. A server still set to `r2` stops at boot with `unknown storage type: r2`. (#3394)
- **React kit (`@stigmer/react-sdk`)**: the console's screens are redrawn on the kit's shared parts. (#3186, #3209)
  - Removed: `useManagingPlugin` and `PLUGIN_LABEL`. (#3231)
  - An `endUser` chat no longer offers the harness picker. (#3248)

## What's Changed

### Features

- feat(operator): one install for Kubernetes (#3394)

name: Release v0.2.0
body:
## Install

```bash
npm install -g @stigmer/cli
```

## Highlights

**Let your coding agent set Stigmer up.** Paste one prompt into Claude Code, Codex or Cursor, and it installs the command line, runs `stigmer coding-agent`, and follows the guide it prints.

**Runs wait for a sandbox instead of failing.** When every sandbox is busy, a new run waits (and says so) and starts within seconds of room appearing, up to `STIGMER_SANDBOX_WAIT_SECONDS` (900 by default).

## Upgrading

- **React kit (`@stigmer/react-sdk`)**: a redesign changes the look of most session and console parts; no prop is renamed except as listed here.
  - Removed: `FileReviewDock`, `FileReviewCard` (and their props types).
  - Changed words: "Try again" for "Retry"; the approval card reads Allow / Deny / "Allow all <class>"; the member's role control is named "Change {name}'s role".
- **`@stigmer/client`**: `formatElapsed` writes its second unit in two digits ("1m 05s").
- **`@stigmer/coding-agent-plugin`** and **`@stigmer/examples`** publish for the first time.

## What's Changed

### Features

- feat(cli): `stigmer coding-agent` (#3001)
